content.query:
STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.Employer -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY EmployerId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.Employer;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613
--3557541

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.Employer
--3557541


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.Employer;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.Employer --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[EmployerId]
,[EmployerName]
,[LocationId]
,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]
,[EmployerFaxNumber]
,[EmployerEmailAddress]
,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
,[PartyId]
,[DunsNumber]
,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
,[DunBradstreetBranch]
,[DunBradstreetDivision]
,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
,[DunBradstreetParent]
,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
,[AnzsicClassCode]
,[SectorCode]
,[SicIndustryCode]
,[SmeClassCode]
,[Subsector]
,[EmployerAddress1]
,[EmployerAddress2]
,[EmployerAddress3]
,[EmployerAddress4]
,[CityId]
,[StateId]
,[ZipCode]
,[Country]
,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
,[BusinessNature]
,[EmployerAddressLine1]
,[EmployerAddressLine2]
,[EmployerAddressLine3]
,[EmployerAddressLine4]
,[EmployerCodeTopCompany]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.Employer -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY EmployerId, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.Employer_WITH_DUP_20230613
--3557541
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.Employer
--1180944
